storyboard.learning_objective: See that 5² + 12² = 13² by counting the unit squares built on each side of a right triangle.

beats.name: triangle
beats.description: Draw the right triangle and its side lengths
beats.caption: A right triangle with legs 5 and 12
beats.narration: Here is a right triangle with legs 5 and 12 and hypotenuse 13.

beats.name: square_a
beats.description: Square on leg a, as a grid of unit cells
beats.caption: Leg 5: square of area 5² = 25
beats.narration: The square on the leg of length 5 holds 25 unit squares.

beats.name: square_b
beats.description: Square on leg b, as a grid of unit cells
beats.caption: Leg 12: square of area 12² = 144
beats.narration: The square on the leg of length 12 holds 144 unit squares.

beats.name: square_c
beats.description: Square on the hypotenuse, as a grid of unit cells
beats.caption: Hypotenuse 13: area 13² = 169
beats.narration: The square on the hypotenuse, of length 13, holds 169 unit squares.

beats.name: equation
beats.caption: The two smaller areas add up to the largest
beats.narration: Add the two smaller areas: 25 plus 144 is 169.

beats.name: hold
beats.caption: So 5² + 12² = 13²
beats.narration: So 5 squared plus 12 squared equals 13 squared.
